A '''musket''' was a pre-industrial military [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] weapon with slow reload time and only one round.<ref name="TRG1" /> Legendary bounty hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] carried a version of this weapon with him aboard his ship, [[Slave I/Legends|Slave I]].
